import json,sys
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests']
from cli import run
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
names=['A','B','C','D']

jobs=[]
# job 1: full transport+file handoff
jobs.append({'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':[
 {'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'contains(A,B) allow; match(C,D) drop;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[1,1,1],'service':'A'},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[2,2,2],'service':'B'},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[1,1,1],'rid':1},
 {'op':'open','connection':[9,3]},
 {'op':'send','unit':[1,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[9,3],'stream':7,'destination':'B'},
 {'op':'recv','connection':[9,3],'stream':7,'unit':[2,2,2],'rid':2,'wire':None},
 {'op':'store','unit':[2,2,2],'rid':2,'file':[4,4]},
 {'op':'clone','parent':[2,2,2],'child':[3,3,3]},
 {'op':'load','file':[4,4],'unit':[3,3,3],'rid':5},
 {'op':'finish','unit':[3,3,3],'rid':5},
 {'op':'finish','unit':[3,3,3],'rid':2},
 {'op':'inspect'},
 {'op':'exit','unit':[2,2,2]},
 {'op':'retire','epoch':1},
 {'op':'inspect'},
]})
# job 2: invalid (bad label)
jobs.append({'services':[{'name':'A','label':0}],'limits':LIM,'events':[]})
# job 3: heavy rejection stream
jobs.append({'services':reg,'limits':dict(LIM,units=1,contexts=1),'events':[
 {'op':'stage','epoch':2,'policy':'startswith(A) allow;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':2},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[1,1,1],'service':'C'},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[1,2,1],'service':'C'},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[1,1,1],'rid':1},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[1,1,1],'rid':2},
 {'op':'inspect'},
